meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 给选定的 NanoClaw 智能体装上 Dial 容器工具:`dial` CLI 进容器 PATH,配 dial-cli 技能和 OneCLI 凭证注入,可从沙箱内发短信、打 AI 语音电话、收验证码;未选中的智能体在网关被拦截。可重复运行来改名单。
howto.when: 当你想让智能体在聊天里发短信、打电话,或直接运行 `dial …`,又不把 Dial 接成消息渠道时使用。需在主机 NanoClaw 仓库里执行,且已装好 OneCLI。

say.text: 给智能体加上 Dial 工具,让它们能发短信和打电话
say.note: 会先列出智能体,让你选谁能用

say.text: 只让 ag-abc 用 Dial,其他智能体都拦住
say.note: 按 agent id 开通,其余在网关被拦

say.text: 重新跑一次,把能用 Dial 的智能体换成 ag-xyz
say.note: 可重复执行,只改授权名单

howto.what_en: Installs Dial as a container tool for chosen NanoClaw agents: the `dial` CLI on PATH, the dial-cli skill, and an OneCLI key for api.getdial.ai, so they can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive codes. Unchosen agents get 403.
howto.when_en: Use when you want agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat without wiring Dial as a messaging channel. Run from the NanoClaw repo on the host; OneCLI must already be installed.

say_en.text: Add the Dial tool so my agents can text and call
say_en.note: It lists agent groups and asks who may use Dial

say_en.text: Only let ag-abc use Dial, block the others
say_en.note: Scopes the key to that agent; the rest are blocked

say_en.text: Re-run it and switch Dial access to ag-xyz
say_en.note: Idempotent; only the allowed list changes
